title: SpaceX returned its Starship rocket on Saturday—but there's a catch
summary: The Space Shuttle was nearly a fully reusable space launch system, but it fell far short of low-cost, rapid launch. SpaceX has now returned both elements of a Starship rocket safely to its launch tower.
